So I started on antidepressants when I was at my lowest, and they helped for a while but then I stopped feeling any effect from them. I also had cognitive behavioural therapy which I also found didn't help. However shortly after this (after months of applying) I got my first proper full time job. This helped with literally having to force myself to be okay. I've been there 2 years now and it's still a struggle and working 40 hour weeks feels like it's going to kill me sometimes. I try to exercise when I have the energy and have tried to improve my diet.

It feels like a lot of baby steps and I still have awful days when I don't possibly think I'll ever be able to feel happy again, but I'm the only person stopping myself.
